meta.method: Each comparison is one paper's table with >= 4 models on the same benchmark, protocol, metric and train fraction (original results only; ablations and non-foundation baselines dropped). Scores are z-scored within the comparison, so paper and benchmark offsets cancel, and averaged per model. Independent = comparisons from papers that did not introduce the model (each model release is its own team; a lab's later paper counts as independent for its earlier models). Win rate = share of other models in the comparison that the model beats. Ranked by independent mean z; imagery benchmarks only. A model is ranked only with >= 10 independent comparisons on >= 5 benchmarks; others are listed unranked.
meta.scope_rule: Within a domain or subdomain a model is ranked with >= 5 independent comparisons on >= 2 benchmarks.
